annotations.title: Check availability at stores near a postcode

description: Checks the availability of 1-3 products (EANs) at every OBI, Bauhaus, toom, Hornbach, hagebau and Globus store within radiusKm (1-30, default 10) of a German postal code, based on the retailers' pages. Returns per product and retailer: status (read; not_listed_in_our_data = watch.diy knows no listing of this product at that retailer, which may still sell it; no_store_in_radius), the retailer's product name, its product page url, price with priceAsOf (a price older than 35 days is returned as null with priceNote), online with onlineAsOf (orderable or not_orderable: whether the retailer sells it online or to order, for the whole retailer and not a store; null when unknown or older than 35 days), and stores [{name, city, zip, km, state, updated}]. Store state is one of available, not_available, not_sold_in_store, unknown: available (the retailer's page shows it as available at that store), not_available (the retailer's page shows it as not available at that store; it does not mean the store never carries it), not_sold_in_store (the retailer does not sell it in that store), unknown (no information for that store). updated is "recently" (within the last 24 hours) or a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Also returns partial (true when there is no information for some stores), location {plz, radiusKm} and a notice. Can take a few seconds. Limits: public lookups are limited per client and per day. Errors: invalid_request (names the field and the reason, e.g. an unknown postal code), quota_exceeded (with the minutes until it can be tried again), public_unavailable.
name: where_to_buy_nearby

partial.description: true = no information for some stores in the radius (state unknown)

online.description: Whether the retailer sells it online or to order (for the whole retailer, not a store); null when unknown or older than 35 days

onlineAsOf.description: When the online status was read (ISO 8601, UTC)

price.description: EUR; null when unknown or older than 35 days

priceAsOf.description: When the price was read (ISO 8601, UTC)

priceNote.description: Present when a known price is hidden for its age

state.description: available | not_available | not_sold_in_store | unknown (no information for this store)

updated.description: "recently" (within the last 24 hours) or the date (YYYY-MM-DD); null when unknown

title: Check availability at stores near a postcode
